recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, two-tone composition featuring a large, textured red lipstick kiss mark centered on a stark white background, flanked by asymmetrical typography in the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The central red graphic acts as the primary organic shape against a sterile white void.
The top-left script typography balances the bottom-right typewriter text.
The rough, stippled texture of the kiss contrasts with the clean, sharp edges of the background.
coreInvariants: Pure white background with zero gradient.
Single-color red graphic with visible vertical 'lip line' striations.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The kiss mark is centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the horizontal frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated red mass of the lips serves as the immediate focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left script, moves down to the central red graphic, and settles on the small text in the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounds the central icon, pushing it forward and emphasizing the texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant, warm red (approx. Hex #D32F2F) for the central icon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against a zero-saturation background creates a vibrating edge effect.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly three colors: Red, White, Black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of fluid, connected script and rigid, monospaced typewriter forms.
letterConstructionRules: Top-left text uses a thick-to-thin brush script with a slight upward slant.
Bottom-right text uses a distressed, monospaced typewriter style with uneven ink distribution.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'l' and 'y' have elongated, sweeping descenders.
Typewriter characters feature slight 'ink bleed' or 'clogged' counters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, human-made script and mechanical, machine-made typewriter text.
graphicDevices: Distressed edges on the central icon to simulate a physical stamp.

avoid: Clean, vector-perfect edges on the kiss mark

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Brush Script (e.g., Thirsty Script or Reklame Script)
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, bold, and slightly retro feel of the top-left text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rough Typewriter (e.g., American Typewriter or Trixie)
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mechanical, slightly imperfect look of the bottom-right text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution, textured red lipstick kiss mark on a pure white background. The kiss should have visible vertical ridges and slightly feathered, organic edges. Ensure the red is vibrant and saturated.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase script text in the top-left corner and lowercase typewriter text in the bottom-right corner. Both should be solid black and positioned with significant padding from the edges.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without any shadows or gradients?
Is the kiss mark the only red element in the composition?
Are the two text blocks placed in opposite corners (top-left and bottom-right)?

adjustableVariables: Amount of 'ink bleed' on the typewriter font
mustRedesign: Avoid any photographic realism; maintain a graphic, screen-printed aesthetic.
Ensure the text does not touch or overlap the central red graphic.

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Check for any unintended gray tones in the background.
Verify that the script font is legible despite its bold weight.
Ensure the typewriter text has a subtle 'stamped' texture.
Confirm the red color is consistent across the entire lip graphic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central organic icon + high-contrast two-tone palette + asymmetrical corner-weighted typography.
